story.heroEyebrow: FOR INDEPENDENT TUTORS AND SMALL CLASSES
story.heroBody: Set a goal for your class. Tiza prepares individual exercises for you to review, then records the answers for your next lesson.
story.heading: Today, equivalent fractions.
story.intro: See how one lesson becomes individual practice and a summary for the teacher.
story.goal.label: The lesson
story.practice.label: The practice
story.return.label: The next class
story.goal.title: Choose what to practise next.
story.goal.body: Your class has worked on equivalent fractions. Set the next goal: adding fractions with different denominators.
story.goal.detail: Add your worksheet and set a time budget. Review the proposed concepts and each learner’s exercises before publishing.
story.goal.takeaway: Editing a plan requires a new approval.
story.goal.caption: Next goal: add fractions with different denominators.
story.goal.alt: A tutor with a large blue pencil prepares a lesson using a yellow and blue fraction circle.
story.practice.title: Give each learner the practice they need.
story.practice.body: A learner with no recorded answers starts with a short check. A learner who struggled with denominators gets practice on that step.
story.practice.detail: Learners answer one question at a time. Hints are available, and follow-up exercises stay within the plan you approved.
story.practice.takeaway: Attempts record whether the learner used a hint.
story.practice.caption: A short check, then focused practice.
story.practice.alt: An adult learner on a mint stool holds a large notebook with a yellow and blue fraction diagram.
story.return.title: Plan the next lesson from their answers.
story.return.body: See who responded, which answers need review and who has not started. Open the attempts behind each observation.
story.return.detail: Use the suggested opening activity or choose your own. An unanswered question stays unanswered; it is not marked wrong.
story.return.takeaway: Every observation links to the attempts behind it.
story.return.caption: Review the fraction calculation together.
story.return.alt: A tutor and adult learner return to an open book with a fraction diagram and a checked answer.
story.endingBody: The demo includes fictional learners with different practice histories. Create a cycle and compare their plans.
